answer: KPMG LLP performed a limited assurance engagement under ISAE (UK) 3000 over Unilever plc's Consolidated Sustainability Statement on pages 213–277, including incorporated-by-reference information, as at and for the year ended 31 December 2025. The conclusion does not extend to accompanying Other Information.

scope_boundary.excluded: Other Information accompanying or containing the Sustainability Statement and assurance report
